proof_summary: The small cases are settled directly, with minimality at 81 proved by expanding a number and its reversal modulo 81 in terms of their digit sum and weighted digit sums, which forces any positive joint multiple below 999999999 to have an impossible digit sum divisible by 81. For every larger exponent, repeatedly tripling the decimal block of 4899999987 yields a number and reversal divisible by the required power of 3—each tripling contributes another factor of 3—whose digit length is strictly too short to reach the all-9s value.
